_generated: Rendered by `squadhq render` from squadhq.yml. Do not edit by hand: edit squadhq.yml and re-render.

_docs.merge_mode: Per project, rendered from squadhq.yml (policies.merge.mode / projects[].merge_mode). 'approver': a human in the approver set merges; nothing auto-merges. 'risk_based': the self-merge job merges a bot PR only when squadhq.merge_policy finds it within merge.risk_based (max_risk, passing checks) and outside merge.always_human; otherwise an approver merges. 'auto': the self-merge job merges as soon as the Reviewer applies 'ready-to-merge', leaving branch protection's required checks as the only gate. Never use 'auto' unless the hub's default branch is protected and SAST, SCA and secret scanning are required checks.
_docs.integration_branch: The branch the Engineer and Architect branch from and target. In a single-branch model it is also the production branch.
_docs.packs: Stack packs from packs/<id>/ that apply to this project (see packs/README.md). Order does not matter.
_docs.pack_roots: Optional per-pack working directory, relative to the repo root, when a pack's code does not live at the pack's default root.
_docs.quality: Quality gates (squadhq.yml projects[].quality): arch auto|required|off, lint auto|default|off, changed_coverage enforce|report|off. Read by `squadhq.packs ci-plan`; see docs/concepts/quality-gates.md.
_docs.frontend_url: Public URL of the product, used by the SEO and Growth agents. Optional.
_docs.keywords: Search terms target users would use; used by the SEO and Growth agents.
_docs.markets: Jurisdictions and audiences; used by the Legal and Growth agents.
_docs.notes: Plain-language positioning: what the product does, who it is for, what it must never claim. Read by the reporting agents and the Product Owner.
